tight_window_model.conclusion: Tight window does not beat a flat baseline on val either -- window misalignment does not appear to be the root cause.

liquidity_interaction_model.conclusion: Liquidity interaction does not beat a flat baseline on val -- Polymarket's own liquidity does not explain the instability either.

multiple_testing_note: 3 new forms tested here (tight window, liquidity interaction, combined), on top of 7 from scripts 24-26 -- running total 10 forms compared. Any held_out_test_r2 reported above beating a flat baseline should be read against this count, per Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016).
